label: Turn the channel off if the Venezuela warnings do not come to pass
description: He tells the audience to turn his own channel off and not watch him if what he warned about Venezuela shows no accuracy in the news, says he does not want to cause confusion in their houses, adds that he could have missed it even though he believes the Lord told him to do this, and says he hates the dogmatism and the pride behind it. A standing invitation to be disbelieved, tied to a named country.

label: A red sky and acid rain over Taiwan, with Australia looking on
description: Red seen all around Taiwan like a sunset or a red dawn, described as acid rain over the island, with Australia looking on and looking up and out, given inside the valley of decision material. He does not say what the red is.

label: The next strike on Iran is set in stone and larger than Midnight Hammer
description: Something about to happen in Iran said to be mainly Israel with America backing it, on the pattern of the Midnight Hammer strike but bigger, and stated as already in motion, already happened and set in stone, with Iran taken quickly. Unusual for carrying no conditionality and no prayer clause.

label: China builds ground drones for drone wars instead of soldiers
description: Chinese drones built not for the sky but for the battlefield so that soldiers do not have to be sent out, fighting drone wars, with fifty calibre guns mounted on tracks and a circular shield he compares to the one in the film Alien.

label: A new gold rush into old mines and creek beds
description: Gold at all-time highs prompting people to sell what they have and to reopen dormant mines in Colorado, Utah and parts of California, panning creek beds for small amounts said to be worth a great deal, with the words new gold rush heard in the headlines worldwide and especially in America. He notes the mines are dangerous.

label: A black 25 coming up out of the ground on pink paper
description: A recurring number twenty five seen coming up out of the ground, written in black on a small pink piece of paper of a lower denomination. He says he does not know what it is, still does not, and only believes it may be a rate.

label: Five pots, a blessing and a warning in each
description: Five pots seen over America with a blessing in each one and a warning attached to each, one carrying a western covered wagon.

label: Russian troops arrive in Venezuela saying they are keeping the peace
description: Russian troops seen entering Venezuela in small numbers despite being stretched in Ukraine, presented as peacekeeping, leading to a turf war involving Russia over Venezuela and Cuba.

label: American troops on the ground destroying cocaine plants
description: American forces described as already on the ground taking out key targets in a ground invasion, cocaine plants burning with powder alight, Marines and men trained like Navy SEALs bringing people out, and large drug factories worked by what look like slave labourers around Venezuela, Cuba and Colombia.

label: A cocaine highway running through Europe, Canada and Asia
description: The trade framed as not only America's: a cocaine trafficking highway running throughout Europe, through America, into Canada and into parts of Asia, given as the reason the drug lords are upset.

label: The man over Cuba hiding underground in the side of a cliff
description: The Cuban leader seen underground in the side of a cliff with a light on and soldiers around him, wearing a blue shirt.

label: Free Palestine picketing in America over the rebuilt Gaza
description: People picketing with signs in America and at Gaza, chanting Free Palestine and angry that the land is not being given back to the Palestinians and that a resort is being built on it.
